# Twinthos

> Twinthos is a UK managed AI-employee company. It runs a digital employee for small businesses: it handles routine admin and follow-ups, logs every step, and returns time to the owner.

## Pages
- [Home](https://twinthos.com/): what Twinthos does
- [How it works](https://twinthos.com/how-it-works/): the service process
- [Pricing](https://twinthos.com/pricing/): plans and fees
- [Security](https://twinthos.com/security/): data handling
- [FAQ](https://twinthos.com/faq/): common questions
- [Notes](https://twinthos.com/notes/): short sourced pieces on the work
